correctness.rationale: Complementary Beatty membership is w(m)=floor((m+1)alpha)-floor(m alpha), alpha=1/phi and beta=1-alpha. The convolution r(n)=sum_{m=1}^{n-1}w(m)(1-w(n-m)) reduces to counting irrational rotation points in a moving interval of length g({n alpha}), with g(t)=beta-t on [0,beta], t-beta on [beta,2beta], beta on [2beta,1]. Every Fibonacci-convergent block has O(1) uniform interval discrepancy and Zeckendorf decomposition uses O(log n) blocks, yielding r(n)=n*g({n alpha})+O(log n) uniformly. Equidistribution and continuity of g give density 2 on (0,beta), plus endpoint atom 1-2beta=sqrt(5)-2; moments follow by integration. Counts ordered positive U+V representations only.
